$comment: Workforce risks for Deep Frontier (Timberborn 1.1.2.8, Iron Teeth): industrial injuries, bot wear, beaver-only crews and specialist-only crews.
Applied to generated blueprints by tools/workforce_risk_content.mjs; checked by tools/validate_workforce_risks.mjs. Runtime: src/DeepFrontier/Scripts/Workforce/.

Worker condition: exhausted = wellbeing below exhaustedBelowWellbeing or the fatigue need critical (native Sleep at or below 0); otherwise strained = wellbeing below strainedBelowWellbeing or fatigue points below strainedBelowFatiguePoints (tired; native Sleep spans -0.2..0.8 and drains 0.6/day awake); otherwise fit.

Injury chance per worker-hour for a fit worker = settings.nativeChances[tier.probability] / tier.rollIntervalHours, times the game mode's native InjuryChance (Easy 0.3, Normal/Hard 1.0). Strained workers are rolled strainedRolls times, exhausted ones exhaustedRolls times.

botWear is the bot deterioration multiplier while a bot is inside that workplace (native Iron Teeth bot life: 70 days). It is required for open workplaces with a danger tier and forbidden on beaver-only crews.

workers: open = native worker types unchanged (bots allowed after their native science unlock); beavers = DisallowOtherWorkerTypes, no bot unlock; specialists = beavers trained in the named discipline only.

Every adult beaver studies in its free time; nobody staffs the school (staff would work the same shift during which students are at work). Each school teaches one profession, chosen in its panel; three schools teach all three at once.

The school is a native goods-consuming attraction (vanilla Detailer pattern: GoodConsumingBuildingSpec + GoodConsumingAttractionSpec + AttractionSpec): it uses up its supplies (goods per hour) while anyone studies inside and turns students away when they run out or it has no power. Its AttractionSpec lists every study need; the runtime keeps only the taught profession's.

Study needs (NeedSpec Study<Discipline> from vanilla Need.Beaver.Books, one per profession). A beaver who holds the profession keeps it full, so it never visits a school teaching what it knows, and its favorableWellbeing counts for every profession it holds. pointsPerHour fills the need while studying; SatisfyToMaxValue keeps a visit going until it is full.
studyHours: hours inside a school teaching the profession that make a graduate. students: seats (native EnterableSpec capacity; the native attraction panel shows one slot per seat and needs a limit).

botMaintenance.$comment: Written by tools/bot_upkeep_content.mjs as FrontierBotMaintenanceSpec on every open template with botWear (runtime: Scripts/Workforce/BotMaintenance.cs). Bots working there take one dose from the building's own maintenance inventory per serviceHours of wear; while it lasts the workplace botWear is multiplied by the good's factor (never below 1x). goods: [good, wearFactor], best first; a bot takes the first one in stock. The inventory is stocked only while a bot is assigned.

botAssembly.$comment: Industrial bot: a second product-less recipe at the vanilla Bot Assembler (same-path patch, tools/bot_upkeep_content.mjs). It builds the ordinary Iron Teeth bot (native BotFactory has a single BotSpec template) three times faster than the native 72 h recipe, from Precision Machine Works parts and a power module battery pack.

Buildings/Power/NuclearReactor/NuclearRe.reason: Reactor control: trained operators only; no bots in the control room.

Buildings/Metal/LaunchPad/LaunchPad.Iron.reason: Launch crew: trained flight engineers only.

Buildings/Metal/UraniumProcessingPlant/U.reason: Radioactive handling: beavers risk the worst accidents, bots burn out in 14 days.

Buildings/Metal/RadioactiveWasteRefinery.reason: Radioactive handling, as the uranium plant.

Buildings/Metal/DeepMine/DeepMine.IronTe.reason: Permanent deep shafts; mechanical rather than radiation wear on bots.

Buildings/Metal/SteelMill/SteelMill.Iron.reason: Electric-arc melt shop and teeming ladles: trained metallurgists only, no bots on the pouring floor.

Buildings/Science/ArchiveExcavation/Arch.reason: Explosive charges and timber shoring in human ruins. Its BotPartFactory template's native injuries are replaced by this tier.
